newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo Nikkei ends year's final session flat.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo Nikkei ends year's final session flat.

text.p: The Tokyo stock market's benchmark Nikkei index ended the final session of 1996 on Monday little changed, recovering after a dip of over 260 points early on.
The losses were brought on by the yen's weakening against the dollar and fears that trade related to expiry of margin accounts would weigh down the index, brokers said.
The Nikkei 225 ended 7.69 points or 0.04 percent lower at 19,361.35, after slipping to 19,108.50 at one stage during the two-hour session. Its March futures fell 100 points to 19,300.
"Sentiment was glum to begin with and it was aggravated further by the yen's tumble to the 116 yen to the dollar level," said Masaaki Higashida, a strategist at Nomura Securities.

But market participants fervently hoping that the Nikkei average would end the year on a favourable tone pushed the index up in the final minutes of trade, leading it into backwardation, with the futures price lower than the spot price, brokers said.
